extDescription.message: See who unfollowed you or doesn’t follow you back on Instagram. Compare follower lists and track changes locally.

ext_tagline.message: See who doesn’t follow you back on Instagram – local and free

scan_resuming.message: Resuming the interrupted scan (accounts already fetched: {n})…

scan_progressSaved.message: Progress saved (accounts: {n}). Click Resume scan to finish.

welcome_lead.message: The extension compares your Instagram followers and following lists. It runs in your browser, with no account and no data sent to the author.

welcome_step1.message: Log in on instagram.com in this browser.

welcome_step2.message: Click Scan – large accounts can take a few minutes.

welcome_step3.message: Browse the tabs, filters and statistics. Unfollow one account at a time.

welcome_riskText.message: The extension uses the unofficial API of the Instagram website. Instagram’s terms do not allow automated data collection, so you use it at your own risk.

welcome_risk1.message: scan at most once a day, at the safe speed,

welcome_risk2.message: unfollow calmly – the extension enforces breaks and a daily limit,

welcome_risk3.message: after an action block, wait a day or two.

welcome_accept.message: I understand and want to use the extension.

welcome_privacy.message: Your data stays in this browser.

set_linkedinLabel.message: Author’s LinkedIn profile (opens in a new tab)

set_reportHint.message: Something not working? A report contains only the extension version, your browser and the last error – no account names.

report_buttonTitle.message: Open a pre-filled report on GitHub (version, browser, error)

report_mailIntro.message: Describe what happened and what you were trying to do:

page_tagline.message: See who doesn’t follow you back on Instagram – local and free

page_lead.message: Apex Unfollowers compares your Instagram followers and following lists: it shows who doesn’t follow you back, who you don’t follow and who unfollowed you. It runs locally in your browser. It needs no account, never asks for your password and sends no data to the author.

page_feat1.message: Don’t follow back – with a whitelist for celebrities and brands

page_feat2.message: Changes – who left and who joined since the last scan

page_feat4.message: Unfollow – one at a time, with confirmation and a daily limit

page_done.message: All set. Open Instagram and click the pink button in the bottom-right corner.

page_privacyText.message: Scan results, history and settings stay in your browser. The extension requests data from Instagram and may load profile photos from Instagram or Meta image servers. There is no telemetry.

err_checkpoint.message: Instagram wants to confirm it is you. Open instagram.com, complete the check and try again later.

err_login.message: Instagram asks you to log in again. Log in and try once more.

err_noAccess.message: Access denied – make sure you are logged in on instagram.com and reload the page.

err_ratelimit.message: Instagram is still limiting requests. Wait 15–30 minutes and try again at the safe speed.

err_format.message: Instagram changed its data format – the extension needs an update.

err_noAccount.message: No logged-in account found. Log in on instagram.com and reload the page.

note_pause.message: Short break ({s} s) to go easy on Instagram…

note_slowDown.message: Instagram asks to slow down (HTTP {status}). Waiting {s} s, then continuing…

note_fallback.message: Main method failed, trying the fallback…

note_repair.message: Instagram returned {got} of {expected} accounts – fetching the rest another way…

scan_first.message: This is your first scan – next time you will see who unfollowed you.

scan_changes.message: Since the previous scan: −{lost} / +{gained} followers (see Changes).

scan_noChanges.message: No changes since the previous scan.

scan_fewer.message: Followers: got {got} of {expected} per the profile counter. A small gap is normal (suspended and deactivated accounts); if it is larger, scan again later.

scan_shortFollowing.message: Warning: following – got {got} of {expected} per the profile counter. Instagram did not return the full list, so the tabs may be inaccurate. Scan again in 15 minutes at the safe speed.

scan_noCounts.message: Could not read your profile counters, so the extension could not check that the lists are complete.

scan_aborted.message: Scan stopped. Previous results were kept.

unf_otherAccount.message: You are logged into a different account than these results. Scan this account first.

unf_blockedUntil.message: Unfollowing paused until {time} because Instagram limited actions on your account.

unf_limit.message: Daily unfollow limit reached ({used}/{limit} in 24 h). You can change it in Settings.

unf_cooldown.message: Wait another {s} s. Breaks between unfollows protect your account.

unf_blocked.message: Instagram blocked this action (too many actions). Unfollowing paused until {time}. Do not retry manually in the app.

unf_slow.message: Instagram asks to slow down. Unfollowing paused until {time}.

unf_failed.message: Instagram did not confirm the unfollow (HTTP {status}, {info}). Check that profile to see if you still follow it.

unf_noTokens.message: Instagram session tokens were not found on the page. Reload the page (F5) and try again.

unf_still.message: Instagram answered, but you still follow @{user}. Try later or from that profile.

unf_unconfirmed.message: Instagram accepted the request, but the extension could not confirm that @{user} is unfollowed. Check that profile.

backup_invalid.message: This is not an Apex Unfollowers backup or the file is damaged.

backup_tooBig.message: The backup file is too large (max {mb} MB).

ui_csvTitle.message: Download the visible list as CSV

ui_footer.message: Your data stays in your browser only.

tab_changesTitle.message: People who unfollowed you (based on scan history)

set_unfHint.message: Instagram limits the number of actions. Too many unfollows in a short time can block actions on your account for hours or days. The extension enforces a 15-second break between unfollows.

set_launcherLabel.message: Show the round button on instagram.com

set_backupHint.message: A JSON file with scan results, history, whitelist and settings. Useful when moving to another computer or browser.

set_dataHint.message: Deletes scan results, history, whitelist and the unfollow counter of the current account.

set_wiped.message: Saved data for this account was deleted.

row_hideTitle.message: Add to whitelist (e.g. celebrities, brands) – it will not be listed here

row_unfTitle.message: Stop following this account (asks for confirmation)

empty_changes.message: No changes recorded yet. Scan again later – this is where you will see who unfollowed you and who joined.

empty_loggedOut.message: Log in to Instagram to see your results. Saved scans stay in the extension and come back when you log in to the same account.

empty_noScan.message: Click Scan to fetch your lists. Large accounts can take a few minutes – you can close the panel, but keep the Instagram tab open.

empty_noResults.message: No accounts match this search or filter.

empty_notBack.message: Everyone you follow follows you back 🎉

empty_fans.message: You follow all of your followers.

stats_chartEmpty.message: The chart appears after your second scan.

csv_empty.message: Nothing to export in this tab.

popup_openText.message: The extension works on instagram.com. Log in, then click the extension icon or the pink button in the bottom-right corner of the page.

popup_reloadText.message: The extension loads after the tab is reloaded. Then click the icon again.
